title: XSched: Preemptive Scheduling for Diverse XPUs
problem: Existing schedulers cannot efficiently manage preemption across diverse accelerators (XPUs) with heterogeneous architectures and capabilities. Coordinating task placement and preemption across multiple XPU types remains challenging.
motivation: As datacenters increasingly deploy heterogeneous accelerators, efficient preemptive scheduling across diverse XPUs is essential for maximizing resource utilization and reducing application latency.
method: XSched implements a preemptive scheduling framework that supports context switching and task migration across different XPU architectures. The scheduler uses workload-aware policies to make placement decisions and manage preemption boundaries, adapting scheduling strategies to each XPU type's characteristics and performance model.
key_novelty: Preemptive scheduling abstraction that unifies diverse XPU types with different architectures into a single scheduling framework while maintaining efficiency.
contributions: Preemptive scheduler supporting multiple heterogeneous accelerators
Context switching and task migration mechanisms across diverse XPU types
Workload-aware scheduling policies for heterogeneous hardware
Experimental validation of performance improvements over baseline schedulers
